source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Ask the municipality for how long its water has failed. Most
   inspections occur every 120 days if that is state-mandated, so multiply
   by that or 30 if you get something smaller.
3. Do they report monthly water-quality tests, then? Calculate those
   intervals.
4. If the municipality claims they have sent out press releases, do
   follow up and perform due diligence.
5. See [Example from a New Jersey municipality](http://trentonwater.org/water-quality-reports/).
<eos>
